text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, write stories, and even compose music. For example, you can type a few words, and an AI program will produce a painting or a short poem in seconds. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, learns from existing data and finds patterns. It does not truly feel or understand what it makes. So perhaps AI is not replacing human creativity, but giving us a new tool to explore ideas in fresh and surprising ways.
